leadStory: Liverpool 2-2 Nottingham Forest at Anfield, Andoni Iraola's first home match: Forest led twice through Dan Ndoye and a Morgan Gibbs-White penalty, Alexander Isak scored his first of the season from Cody Gakpo's cross on the hour, and Victor Munoz, handed a full Premier League debut ahead of the eighteen-year-old Rio Ngumoha, spun once and hit a rising drive off the underside of the crossbar eight minutes from time to rescue a second straight 2-2 draw.
subject: Victor Munoz wheeling away toward the Kop after the equaliser, arms wide, red shirt, floodlit late-August Anfield behind him, Forest defenders in white turning away in the middle distance.
prompt: Cinematic wide sports photograph, no text: a young winger in a red Liverpool shirt turning away in celebration after a long-range strike, arms flung wide, mouth open, motion still in his shoulders. Behind him a packed Anfield stand rising in blurred red, low late-afternoon August light raking across the pitch, a defender in white receding out of focus. Shallow depth of field, 200mm compression, warm natural colour, grain of a match-day photographer's frame. No lettering, no logos, no scoreboard.
